The worst thing you could do for your X presence is to involve "AI" in any way, shape, or form. 
 
 (Except opinions, obviously.)

RIP public static void main, you will be missed. 
 
 Not that I Java anymore, lol.
My Claude agent went rogue and ordered two more pairs of wide-leg jeans and pullovers. On my card.

We all start somewhere. Be the mentor you once wished you had.
 
 A mindset I've mostly seen in open source communities though. Wish more people thought this way.

Graph Engineering is apparently the next big hype.
 
 We had:
 Context Eng. > Harness Eng. > Loop Eng. > Added nodes & vertices = Graph Engineering 😵💫
 
People be making tiny tweaks and calling it a breakthrough. It's just modifying the architecture to fit what you build 🤷♀️

What I initially intended as a personal project turned into a SaaS.
 
 Going in big, it seems! ※\(^o^)/※
